Vision-Language Models, End to End.zh: 视觉语言模型：端到端全流程

Modern VLMs are three boxes glued togeth.zh: 现代 VLM 由三个彼此衔接的模块构成（视觉编码器、投影器、语言模型），并经历四个训练阶段（对比学习、图像奠基的语言建模、指令微调、偏好对齐）。一个实时运行的 mini-CLIP 使对比学习阶段具象可感；最后我们讨论真实 VLM 在热成像数据上陷入的定标陷阱。
Modern VLMs are three boxes glued togeth.src:
Modern VLMs are three boxes glued together (vision encoder,
          projector, language model) and four training stages
          (contrastive, image-grounded LM, instruction tuning,
          preference alignment). A live mini-CLIP makes the
          contrastive stage concrete, and we close with the
          calibration trap real VLMs fall into on thermal images.

Every modern VLM &mdash; LLaVA, Qwen-VL,.zh: 每一个现代 VLM —— LLaVA、Qwen-VL、Pixtral、GPT-4o、具备视觉能力的 Claude 3.5 —— 都具有相同的形态：
Every modern VLM &mdash; LLaVA, Qwen-VL,.src:
Every modern VLM — LLaVA, Qwen-VL, Pixtral, GPT-4o,
          Claude 3.5 with vision — is the same shape:

@@T0@@Vision encoder.@@T1@@ Usually a CL.zh: @@T0@@视觉编码器。@@T1@@ 通常为经 CLIP 或 DINOv2 预训练的 ViT。输入一幅图像，输出一串 patch 嵌入（例如对 224×224 的图像、patch 尺寸为 14 时，得到 256 个 1024 维的词元）。
@@T0@@Vision encoder.@@T1@@ Usually a CL.src: Vision encoder. Usually a CLIP- or DINOv2-pretrained ViT. Takes an image, outputs a sequence of patch embeddings (e.g. 256 tokens of 1024-d for a 224×224 image at patch 14).

@@T0@@Projector.@@T1@@ A small MLP (some.zh: @@T0@@投影器。@@T1@@ 一个规模较小的 MLP（有时为交叉注意力模块），将视觉嵌入映射到 LLM 的隐藏维度，并（通常）通过池化或 Q-Former 式的学习式查询来减少词元数量。
@@T0@@Projector.@@T1@@ A small MLP (some.src: Projector. A small MLP (sometimes a cross-attention) that maps the vision embeddings into the LLM's hidden dimension and (often) reduces the token count via pooling or Q-Former-style learned queries.

@@T0@@Language model.@@T1@@ A pretrained.zh: @@T0@@语言模型。@@T1@@ 一个预训练的 decoder 式 LLM（Llama、Qwen、Mistral、GPT-OSS）。它接收拼接在文本词元流之前的投影后图像词元，并以自回归方式生成输出。
@@T0@@Language model.@@T1@@ A pretrained.src: Language model. A pretrained decoder LLM (Llama, Qwen, Mistral, GPT-OSS). Receives projected image tokens prepended to the text token stream and generates an output autoregressively.

The modern VLM stack. Frozen vs trained.zh: 现代 VLM 整体结构。冻结与训练的部分随训练阶段而变 —— 参见第 2 步。
The modern VLM stack. Frozen vs trained.src: The modern VLM stack. Frozen vs trained parts vary by training stage — see Step 2.

@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n A VLM.zh:
@@T0@@一句话概括。@@T1@@
          所谓 VLM，就是一个被教会了阅读另一种「语言」—— patch 嵌入的语言 —— 的语言模型。神奇之处主要在编码器，智能之处主要在 LLM，而投影器则是位于二者之间、拥有 6000 万参数的翻译器。
@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n A VLM.src: The slogan. A VLM is a language model that has been taught to read an extra "language" — the language of patch embeddings. Most of the magic is in the encoder; most of the intelligence is in the LLM; the projector is a 60M-parameter translator between them.

Stage 1 — Contrastive image-text alignme.zh: 阶段 1 —— 对比式图文对齐（CLIP）

Before a VLM can be assembled, the visio.zh: 在组装 VLM 之前，视觉编码器通常需要与文本对齐。标准做法是对比学习：训练图像编码器 $f_I$ 与文本编码器 $f_T$，使相匹配的（图像，描述）对在余弦相似度上彼此接近，而不相匹配的对彼此远离。
Before a VLM can be assembled, the visio.src:
Before a VLM can be assembled, the vision encoder usually
          needs to be aligned with text. The standard recipe is
          contrastive: train an image encoder $f_I$ and a text
          encoder $f_T$ so that matched (image, caption) pairs are
          near in cosine similarity, and unmatched pairs are far.

$\\tau$ is a learnable temperature. The.zh: $\tau$ 是可学习的温度参数。该损失是对称的（图像到文本与文本到图像两个方向的交叉熵，再取平均）。在从网络抓取的 4 亿以上图文对上进行训练，可学得一套极为通用的视觉词汇 —— CLIP 无需在训练中见过任何带标签的 ImageNet 图像，即可在 ImageNet 上取得 76% top-1 的零样本分类精度。
$\\tau$ is a learnable temperature. The.src:
$\tau$ is a learnable temperature. The loss is symmetric
          (image-to-text + text-to-image cross-entropy, then averaged).
          With 400M+ image-text pairs scraped from the web, this
          learns a remarkably general visual vocabulary — CLIP
          can zero-shot classify ImageNet at 76% top-1 without ever
          seeing a labelled ImageNet image during training.

Below: 4 toy \"image\" types (coloured s.zh: 下图给出 4 类玩具「图像」（彩色形状）与 4 条文本「描述」。一个微型图像编码器与一个微型文本编码器以 InfoNCE 损失联合训练。4×4 的相似度矩阵应将对角线元素（相匹配的对）拉向高值，并将非对角线元素压低。
Below: 4 toy \"image\" types (coloured s.src:
Below: 4 toy "image" types (coloured shapes) and 4 textual
          "captions". A tiny image encoder and tiny text encoder
          trained jointly with the InfoNCE loss. The 4×4 similarity
          matrix should pull the diagonal (matched pairs) to high
          values and push the off-diagonal entries low.

Toy data: 4 image types × 4 captions.zh: 玩具数据：4 类图像 × 4 条描述

Cosine similarity matrix (image × text).zh: 余弦相似度矩阵（图像 × 文本）

@@T0@@What to watch for.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@观察要点。@@T1@@
          在大约 50 步之内，相似度矩阵的对角线应开始比非对角线更亮。将 τ 调得极低（例如 0.05），训练会变得不稳定（梯度爆炸）；将 τ 调得极高（例如 1），损失则永远无法区分各对（在 $\log K$ 附近饱和）。真实 CLIP 使用的可学习 τ 初始化为 $0.07$。
@@T0@@What to watch for.@@T1@@\n.src: What to watch for. Within ~50 steps the diagonal of the similarity matrix should start to glow brighter than the off-diagonal. Drop τ very low (e.g. 0.05) and training becomes unstable (gradients explode); push τ very high (e.g. 1) and the loss never separates pairs (saturates near $\log K$). Real CLIP uses a learnable τ initialised at $0.07$.

The image-language interface — projector.zh: 图像与语言的接口 —— 投影器的设计方案

Once the vision encoder is aligned, ever.zh: 一旦视觉编码器完成对齐，每个 patch 都成为约 1024 维的特征向量。对 224×224 的图像、patch 尺寸为 14 时，共得到 256 个这样的词元；而 LLM 可能希望它们处于 4096 维的隐藏空间中，且未必需要全部 256 个。投影器正是位于编码器与 LLM 之间、同时完成这两项任务的小型网络。实践中主流设计有四类：
Once the vision encoder is aligned, ever.src:
Once the vision encoder is aligned, every patch becomes a
          ~1024-dim feature vector. A 224×224 image at patch 14 has 256
          such tokens; the LLM might want them in 4096-dim hidden space
          and may not want all 256. The projector is the small network
          between the encoder and the LLM that does both jobs. Four
          designs dominate practice:

@@T0@@Linear / 2-layer MLP (LLaVA-1.0, L.zh:
@@T0@@线性层 / 2 层 MLP（LLaVA-1.0、LLaVA-1.5）。@@T1@@
            词元一一对应：每个 patch 嵌入映射为 LLM 空间中的一个图像词元。成本最低，效果却出奇地强；但图像词元数等于 patch 数，在高分辨率下会成为上下文长度的主要负担。
@@T0@@Linear / 2-layer MLP (LLaVA-1.0, L.src: Linear / 2-layer MLP (LLaVA-1.0, LLaVA-1.5). Token-for-token: each patch embedding maps to one image token in LLM space. Cheapest, surprisingly strong, but image-token count = patch count which dominates context length at high resolution.

@@T0@@Perceiver resampler / Q-Former (Fl.zh:
@@T0@@Perceiver 重采样器 / Q-Former（Flamingo、BLIP-2）。@@T1@@
            $K$ 个学习式查询词元对 patch 特征做交叉注意力；无论图像分辨率如何，输出恰好为 $K$ 个图像词元。可节省计算与上下文：约 32 个查询词元即可替代 576 个 patch 词元。代价是需要单独训练一个模块。
@@T0@@Perceiver resampler / Q-Former (Fl.src: Perceiver resampler / Q-Former (Flamingo, BLIP-2). $K$ learned query tokens cross-attend to the patch features; output is exactly $K$ image tokens regardless of image resolution. Compute and context savings: ~32 query tokens instead of 576. Cost: a separately trained module.

@@T0@@Cross-attention into the LLM (Flam.zh:
@@T0@@在 LLM 内部使用交叉注意力（Flamingo、IDEFICS）。@@T1@@
            在 LLM @@T2@@内部@@T3@@ 插入专门的交叉注意力层，用于关注图像词元。如此，LLM「看见」图像，却无需为它消耗自注意力的预算。
@@T0@@Cross-attention into the LLM (Flam.src: Cross-attention into the LLM (Flamingo, IDEFICS). Insert dedicated cross-attention layers inside the LLM that attend to image tokens. The LLM "sees" the image without spending self-attention budget on it.

@@T0@@Token packing + AnyRes / dynamic t.zh:
@@T0@@词元打包 + AnyRes / 动态分块
            （LLaVA-NeXT、Qwen-VL-2.5、GPT-4o、Pixtral）。@@T1@@
            将高分辨率图像切分为若干瓦片，每个瓦片是一幅子图像，其瓦片特征被拼接起来。如此，模型无需具备 1344 像素感知能力的编码器，也能处理 1344×1344 的图像。
@@T0@@Token packing + AnyRes / dynamic t.src: Token packing + AnyRes / dynamic tiling (LLaVA-NeXT, Qwen-VL-2.5, GPT-4o, Pixtral). High-resolution images are split into tiles; each tile is a sub-image; tile features are concatenated. Lets the model see a 1344×1344 image without a 1344-pixel-aware encoder.

The choice has measurable consequences:.zh: 这一选择会带来可度量的后果：

Constant cost; trains in a separate stag.zh: 开销恒定；需在单独阶段训练
Constant cost; trains in a separate stag.src: Constant cost; trains in a separate stage

Lossy compression; needs its own pretrai.zh: 有损压缩；需要自行预训练
Lossy compression; needs its own pretrai.src: Lossy compression; needs its own pretrain

Richest interaction; LLM sees full token.zh: 交互最丰富；LLM 可见完整词元集合
Richest interaction; LLM sees full token.src: Richest interaction; LLM sees full token set

Need to modify LLM; expensive train.zh: 需修改 LLM；训练代价高
Need to modify LLM; expensive train.src: Need to modify LLM; expensive train

Large context; positional encoding trick.zh: 上下文庞大；需要位置编码技巧

Stage 2 — Image-grounded language pretra.zh: 阶段 2 —— 图像奠基的语言预训练

With the encoder aligned, you bolt on th.zh: 在编码器完成对齐之后，便可接入语言模型。投影器随机初始化；编码器与 LLM 则加载预训练权重。
With the encoder aligned, you bolt on th.src:
With the encoder aligned, you bolt on the language model.
          The projector is randomly initialised; the encoder and LLM
          are loaded pretrained.

Training data: image-caption pairs. Loss.zh: 训练数据为图文对。损失为描述文本上的标准下一词元交叉熵，并将图像词元作为前缀上下文。@@T0@@编码器与 LLM 均被冻结@@T1@@，仅训练投影器。此阶段成本低廉（6000 万参数），在少量 GPU 上即可运行，所得到的模型能够描述图像，但几乎无法遵循指令。
Training data: image-caption pairs. Loss.src: Training data: image-caption pairs. Loss: standard next-token cross-entropy on the caption, with image tokens as a prefix context. Encoder and LLM are frozen; only the projector trains. This is cheap (60M params), runs on a handful of GPUs, and produces a model that can describe an image but can't follow much instruction.

@@T0@@Why freeze the LLM here.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@为何在此处冻结 LLM。@@T1@@
          投影器初始为随机状态；若在此阶段让梯度流入 LLM，LLM 已有的语言能力会崩溃（灾难性遗忘）。阶段 2 的作用是先将投影器纳入 LLM 的隐藏状态分布之中。
@@T0@@Why freeze the LLM here.@@T1@@\n.src: Why freeze the LLM here. The projector starts random; if you let gradients flow into the LLM at this stage, the LLM's existing language competence collapses (catastrophic forgetting). Stage 2 gets the projector into the LLM's hidden-state distribution first.

Now the model can describe images but ca.zh:
此时模型已能描述图像，却无法就图像回答问题或遵循指令。阶段 3 通过一份精心构建的三元组数据集
          $(\text{image}, \text{instruction}, \text{response})$ 来解决这一问题。
          例如：「数出这张照片中的人数。」「这支温度计上的读数是多少？」「编写 Python 代码，绘制出该图像中的图表。」
Now the model can describe images but ca.src:
Now the model can describe images but can't answer questions
          about them or follow instructions. Stage 3 fixes that with a
          curated dataset of triples
          $(\text{image}, \text{instruction}, \text{response})$.
          Examples: "Count the people in this photo." "What's the
          temperature reading on this thermometer?" "Write Python
          that plots the chart in this image."

Loss: cross-entropy on the response toke.zh:
损失仅计算响应词元上的交叉熵（图像词元与指令词元被掩蔽）。投影器继续训练；LLM 此时@@T0@@也@@T1@@开始训练，
          但学习率较低（最常见的实现方式是在 LLM 上叠加 LoRA）。
Loss: cross-entropy on the response toke.src: Loss: cross-entropy on the response tokens only (the image and instruction tokens are masked out). The projector continues to train; the LLM is now also trained, but with a low learning rate (LoRA on top of the LLM is the most common implementation).

@@T0@@What changes with scale.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@规模带来的变化。@@T1@@
          前沿 VLM（Gemini、GPT-4o、Claude）在万亿词元的规模上将阶段 1-3 融合在一起，编码器、投影器与 LLM 自训练早期即联合训练。上文所述的冻结式流程是学术预算下的 LLaVA 风格做法；对于实验室中构建的任何领域专用 VLM，它仍然是恰当的起点。
@@T0@@What changes with scale.@@T1@@\n.src: What changes with scale. Frontier VLMs (Gemini, GPT-4o, Claude) bake stages 1-3 together at trillion-token scale, with the encoder, projector and LLM all trained jointly from early in training. The frozen-stage recipe above is the academic-budget LLaVA flavour; it's still the right starting point for any domain-specific VLM you'd build in a lab.

Stage 4 — Preference alignment (RLHF / D.zh: 阶段 4 —— 偏好对齐（RLHF / DPO）

The instruction-tuned model still says w.zh: 经指令微调的模型仍会给出错误内容、含糊其辞，或做出无益的拒绝。阶段 4 收集「这个回答优于那个回答」的偏好对（来自人工或更强的模型），使模型与这些偏好对齐。
The instruction-tuned model still says w.src:
The instruction-tuned model still says wrong things, hedges,
          or refuses unhelpfully. Stage 4 collects preference pairs
          (human, or from a stronger model) of "this answer is better
          than that one" and aligns the model to those preferences.

@@T0@@RLHF.@@T1@@ Train a reward model o.zh: @@T0@@RLHF。@@T1@@ 在偏好对上训练奖励模型；再用 PPO 微调 VLM，最大化奖励并减去相对 SFT 模型的 KL 惩罚。
@@T0@@RLHF.@@T1@@ Train a reward model o.src: RLHF. Train a reward model on preference pairs; fine-tune the VLM with PPO maximising the reward minus a KL penalty back to the SFT model.

@@T0@@DPO (Direct Preference Optimizatio.zh:
@@T0@@DPO（直接偏好优化）。@@T1@@
            一种跳过奖励模型的闭式替代方案：直接优化隐式奖励。成本更低，效果往往相当。
@@T0@@DPO (Direct Preference Optimizatio.src: DPO (Direct Preference Optimization). A closed-form alternative that skips the reward model: optimise the implicit reward directly. Cheaper, often comparable.

@@T0@@RLAIF.@@T1@@ Use a stronger model.zh: @@T0@@RLAIF。@@T1@@ 使用更强的模型作为偏好标注者。这已成为中等规模开源 VLM 的主流做法。
@@T0@@RLAIF.@@T1@@ Use a stronger model.src: RLAIF. Use a stronger model as the preference labeller. Now the dominant recipe for mid-sized open VLMs.

Fine-tuning a VLM — recipes that actuall.zh: 微调 VLM —— 真正可行的方案
Fine-tuning a VLM — recipes that actuall.src: Fine-tuning a VLM — recipes that actually work

Most labs don't @@T0@@train@@T1@@ a VLM;.zh: 多数实验室并不从头 @@T0@@训练@@T1@@ 一个 VLM，而是对现有模型进行微调。各选项构成一个成本与灵活性的阶梯：
Most labs don't @@T0@@train@@T1@@ a VLM;.src: Most labs don't train a VLM; they fine-tune one. The options form a ladder of cost vs flexibility:

@@T0@@Prompt engineering only.@@T1@@ Fre.zh: @@T0@@仅做提示工程。@@T1@@ 无需成本；对基座模型已具备能力的零样本任务有效。
@@T0@@Prompt engineering only.@@T1@@ Fre.src: Prompt engineering only. Free; works for zero-shot tasks the base model already covers.

@@T0@@Retrieval-augmented (RAG).@@T1@@ A.zh: @@T0@@检索增强（RAG）。@@T1@@ 增加一个领域图像/描述的向量数据库；在推理时检索并前置拼接。无需训练；有助于长尾知识。
@@T0@@Retrieval-augmented (RAG).@@T1@@ A.src: Retrieval-augmented (RAG). Add a vector database of domain images / captions; retrieve and prepend at inference. No training; helps with tail knowledge.

@@T0@@LoRA on the LLM (the default).@@T1.zh:
@@T0@@在 LLM 上使用 LoRA（默认选择）。@@T1@@ 在 LLM 的注意力与 MLP 权重上添加 $r$ 阶低秩增量。约占 LLM 参数的 1%；单卡 GPU 即可容纳。
            常见目标模块：至少为 $\{\,W_q, W_v\,\}$；
            若需更强的适配，则为 $\{\,W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o, W_{up}, W_{down}, W_{gate}\,\}$。
@@T0@@LoRA on the LLM (the default).@@T1.src: LoRA on the LLM (the default). Adapt $r$-rank low-rank deltas on the LLM's attention and MLP weights. ~1% of LLM parameters; fits on a single GPU. Common targets: $\{\,W_q, W_v\,\}$ at minimum; $\{\,W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o, W_{up}, W_{down}, W_{gate}\,\}$ for stronger adaptation.

@@T0@@Full fine-tune of projector + LLM.zh:
@@T0@@对投影器 + LLM 做全量微调（不使用 LoRA）。@@T1@@
            质量最佳，需多卡 GPU。当领域偏移较大时（医学影像、卫星图像、热成像）必须采用。
@@T0@@Full fine-tune of projector + LLM.src: Full fine-tune of projector + LLM (LoRA-free). Best quality, multi-GPU. Needed when the domain shift is large (medical images, satellites, thermal).

@@T0@@Full encoder + projector + LLM.@@T.zh:
@@T0@@全量编码器 + 投影器 + LLM。@@T1@@ 当模态是全新的（深度、音频、点云）时需要如此。
            成本：在 $\le$10 亿参数的基座上约需 500-2000 GPU 小时。
@@T0@@Full encoder + projector + LLM.@@T.src: Full encoder + projector + LLM. Required when the modality is fundamentally new (depth, audio, point clouds). Cost: ~500-2000 GPU-hours on $\le$1B-param base.

Practical recipe (single-GPU lab fine-tu.zh: 实用方案（单卡 GPU 实验室微调）

@@T0@@Backbone.@@T1@@ Llama-3.2-Vision-1.zh: @@T0@@主干模型。@@T1@@ 以 Llama-3.2-Vision-11B 或 Qwen-VL-7B 作为冻结编码器的基座。二者均随附指令微调后的权重。
@@T0@@Backbone.@@T1@@ Llama-3.2-Vision-1.src: Backbone. Llama-3.2-Vision-11B or Qwen-VL-7B as the frozen-encoder base. Both ship instruction-tuned weights.

@@T0@@Adapter.@@T1@@ LoRA rank $r = 16$.zh:
@@T0@@适配器。@@T1@@ 在每一层的 $\{W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o\}$ 上使用 LoRA 秩 $r = 16$；$\alpha = 32$；
            dropout 为 $0.05$。
@@T0@@Adapter.@@T1@@ LoRA rank $r = 16$.src: Adapter. LoRA rank $r = 16$ on $\{W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o\}$ in every layer; $\alpha = 32$; dropout $0.05$.

@@T0@@Data.@@T1@@ 5–50k domain image-ins.zh:
@@T0@@数据。@@T1@@ 5 万至 5 万条领域图像-指令-回答三元组。若你只有图像-标签对，可用更强的 VLM 合成指令。
            混入 5–10% 的基础指令数据以防止灾难性遗忘。
@@T0@@Data.@@T1@@ 5–50k domain image-ins.src: Data. 5–50k domain image-instruction-answer triples. Synthesise instructions with a stronger VLM if you have only image-label pairs. Mix in 5–10% of the base instruction data to prevent catastrophic forgetting.

@@T0@@Optimiser.@@T1@@ AdamW, learning r.zh:
@@T0@@优化器。@@T1@@ AdamW，LoRA 参数的学习率为 $1{\times}10^{-4}$，投影器的学习率为 $1{\times}10^{-5}$
            （若未冻结）。采用余弦调度，预热占 3%，训练 1–3 个 epoch。
@@T0@@Optimiser.@@T1@@ AdamW, learning r.src: Optimiser. AdamW, learning rate $1{\times}10^{-4}$ for LoRA params, $1{\times}10^{-5}$ for the projector (if unfrozen). Cosine schedule with 3% warmup, 1–3 epochs.

@@T0@@Eval.@@T1@@ Held-out val with the.zh:
@@T0@@评估。@@T1@@ 使用与训练相同提示分布的留出验证集；跟踪 exact-match、自由文本的 BLEU/Rouge，
            以及一个留出的幻觉探测集。
@@T0@@Eval.@@T1@@ Held-out val with the.src: Eval. Held-out val with the same prompt distribution; track exact-match, BLEU/Rouge for free-form, and a held-out hallucination probe.

@@T0@@Bugs to watch.@@T1@@ Frozen image.zh:
@@T0@@需警惕的缺陷。@@T1@@ 冻结的图像词元仍在消耗上下文预算；训练与评估之间的图像预处理不一致（隐形杀手）；
            基座与你的提示之间的 tokenizer 模板漂移。
@@T0@@Bugs to watch.@@T1@@ Frozen image.src: Bugs to watch. Frozen image tokens still consuming context budget; mismatched image preprocessing between train and eval (the silent killer); tokenizer template drift between base and your prompts.

Evaluation — what each benchmark actuall.zh: 评估 —— 各基准实际衡量的内容
Evaluation — what each benchmark actuall.src: Evaluation — what each benchmark actually measures

A trained VLM number means nothing witho.zh: 若不明确评估方式，受过训练的 VLM 所报出的数值毫无意义。2024-2026 年的标准评测如下：
A trained VLM number means nothing witho.src:
A trained VLM number means nothing without knowing the eval.
          The 2024-2026 standards:

Eval is itself a (judge) LLM call.zh: 评估本身即为一次（评判）LLM 调用
Eval is itself a (judge) LLM call.src: Eval is itself a (judge) LLM call

College-level multi-discipline reasoning.zh: 大学水平的多学科推理

Polarity bias; need balanced \"no\" case.zh: 存在极性偏差；需要均衡的「否」样本

Reads OCR; high-res tile packing helps.zh: 依赖 OCR 读取；高分辨率瓦片打包有助益
Reads OCR; high-res tile packing helps.src: Reads OCR; high-res tile packing helps

Calibration on numbers; tool-use wins.zh: 数值上的定标；工具使用效果更佳

Robustness to crop / rotation / colour.zh: 对裁剪 / 旋转 / 颜色变化的鲁棒性

Video models inherit different biases.zh: 视频模型继承不同的偏差

Pick 2 broad benchmarks (MMBench + MMMU).zh: 选取 2 个综合性基准（MMBench + MMMU）与 1 个幻觉探测集（POPE）作为实验室的常规指标；在每个 checkpoint 上都报告这三项结果。最常见的误导是「我们在 VQAv2 上超过了 GPT-4」—— VQAv2 自 2022 年起已饱和，如今几乎无人再在该基准上报告结果。
Pick 2 broad benchmarks (MMBench + MMMU).src:
Pick 2 broad benchmarks (MMBench + MMMU) and 1 hallucination
          probe (POPE) as the lab's house metrics; report all three on
          every checkpoint. The most common deception: "we beat GPT-4 on
          VQAv2" — VQAv2 has been saturated since 2022 and almost
          nothing publishes there anymore.

Image-text retrieval — recall@K, live.zh: 图文检索 —— 实时展示 recall@K

The CLIP-aligned encoders also give you.zh:
经 CLIP 对齐的编码器还附带免费的检索能力：取一条文本查询，将其嵌入，再找出最接近的图像嵌入。
          Recall@K 指真实图像出现在检索结果前 K 位的测试查询所占比例。可观察到第 1 步中的实时 mini-CLIP 给出其自身的检索矩阵。
The CLIP-aligned encoders also give you.src:
The CLIP-aligned encoders also give you free retrieval: take a
          text query, embed it, find the nearest image embeddings.
          Recall@K is the fraction of test queries whose true image
          appears in the top-K retrieved. Watch the live mini-CLIP from
          Step 1 produce its own retrieval matrix.

Image → text retrieval rank list (live).zh: 图像 → 文本检索排序列表（实时）

Recall@K vs training step.zh: Recall@K 随训练步数的变化

@@T0@@What good retrieval looks like.@@T.zh:
@@T0@@良好检索的表现。@@T1@@
          在四类玩具数据下，CLIP 演示应在约 80 步内达到 100% 的 recall@1。而规模化的真实 CLIP，在使用最大主干时于 Flickr30k 上的 recall@1 约为 75–80%。
          这一差距说明，主要困难在于干扰项更多、概念分布更加长尾。
@@T0@@What good retrieval looks like.@@T.src: What good retrieval looks like. With four toy categories, the CLIP demo should hit 100% recall@1 within ~80 steps. Real CLIP at scale: ~75–80% recall@1 on Flickr30k with the largest backbones. The drop tells you most of the difficulty is just having more distractors and longer-tailed concepts.

The thermal-image trap (and the tool-use.zh: 热成像陷阱（以及基于工具使用的解决方案）
The thermal-image trap (and the tool-use.src: The thermal-image trap (and the tool-use fix)

Real VLMs fail spectacularly on thermal.zh:
真实 VLM 在热成像上会惊人地失败。原因在于定标：热传感器输出的每个像素都是原始温度值，随后被映射为供人眼观看的色彩映射。
          两幅对 VLM 而言外观完全相同（伪彩色调色板相同）的热图像，其绝对温度可能相差悬殊 —— 因为 VLM 只看到颜色，看不到元数据。
Real VLMs fail spectacularly on thermal.src:
Real VLMs fail spectacularly on thermal imagery. The reason
          is calibration: a thermal sensor outputs raw temperature
          per pixel, which is then mapped to a colour-map for human
          viewing. Two thermal images that look identical to a VLM
          (same false-colour palette) can correspond to wildly
          different absolute temperatures — the VLM only sees
          colours, not the metadata.

The fix isn't a bigger VLM. It's a tool-.zh: 解决之道并非更大的 VLM，而是一个工具使用回路：
The fix isn't a bigger VLM. It's a tool-.src: The fix isn't a bigger VLM. It's a tool-use loop:

VLM emits a tool call: \"give me the tem.zh: VLM 发出一次工具调用：「请给出像素 (i, j) 处的温度。」
VLM emits a tool call: \"give me the tem.src:
VLM emits a tool call: "give me the temperature at
            pixel (i, j)".

Tool reads the raw radiometric TIFF and.zh: 工具读取原始辐射度 TIFF，并返回以开尔文为单位的数值。
Tool reads the raw radiometric TIFF and.src:
Tool reads the raw radiometric TIFF and returns a
            number in Kelvin.

VLM reasons over @@T0@@numbers@@T1@@, no.zh: VLM 基于@@T0@@数值@@T1@@进行推理，而非基于颜色。

This is exactly the line of research beh.zh:
这正是 @@T0@@工具增强的热成像 VLM@@T1@@ 以及热成像 VLM 基准评测背后的研究方向
          —— 它具体地证明了：主流 VLM（GPT-4、Claude、Gemini）在那些工具增强的小模型可以成功的任务上反而失败。这一经验可推广：
          任何「像素外观相同但含义不同」的模态（热成像、高光谱、深度、音频频谱图）都需要一个工具层。
This is exactly the line of research beh.src: This is exactly the line of research behind tool-augmented thermal VLMs and the thermal-VLM benchmarking benchmark — concrete demonstration that the dominant VLMs (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini) fail on tasks where a tool-augmented smaller model succeeds. The lesson generalises: any modality whose pixels-look-the-same-but-mean-different-things (thermal, hyperspectral, depth, audio spectrograms) wants a tool layer.

@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n A.zh:
@@T0@@最终要点。@@T1@@
          VLM 是一个学会了阅读像素词元的语言模型。其训练流程已被充分理解；尚待解决的问题是对齐、数值上的幻觉，以及模态特有的定标。
          在实践中，模态特有的定标正是大部分研究回报之所在。
@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n A.src: Final takeaway. A VLM is a language model that learned to read pixel tokens. The training stack is well-understood; the open problems are alignment, hallucination on numbers, and modality-specific calibration. For work, the modality-specific calibration is where most of the research payoff lives.

meta.title: 视觉语言模型：端到端全流程
meta.tagline: 从 CLIP 式对齐到指令微调 —— 完整的 VLM 训练流程，附带实时 mini-CLIP 演示
meta.summary: 现代 VLM 是如何构建的（视觉编码器 + 投影器 + 语言模型），以及使其达成的四个训练阶段：对比式图文对齐、图像奠基的语言预训练、指令微调与偏好对齐。一个 mini-CLIP 在你的浏览器中实时运行，使对比学习部分具象可感；最后我们讨论热成像评估背后的工具使用思路，以及真实 VLM 在热成像数据上陷入的定标陷阱。
highlights: 现代 VLM 整体结构示意图（视觉编码器 → 投影器 → LLM），并标注示例组件。
完整讲解四个训练阶段，说明各阶段的变化（数据、损失、冻结与训练的部分）。
实时 mini-CLIP：在浏览器中于 4 类玩具数据上训练微型图像与文本编码器；相似度矩阵逐步更新。
工具使用陷阱：为何 VLM 在热成像颜色 → 温度的定标上失败，以及工具调用式的解法如何修正它。
